title: Muhammad NDE 2479
content: I was out of my office after work, when I wanted to pass the road I saw a car in high speed coming in my direction. After a few seconds I felt a strange comfortable feeling I didn't have it before at although the hard of the accident. The accident was at 11:00 in the morning. After, I felt as if I was flying on the air. Though the weather was very hot, I couldn't feel the heat. Then I heard somebody in the road tried to get me to say the words which Muslims say before dying which is 'No Gods but one God, and Muhammad is a prophet of the God.' Then I felt very happy moments I didn't experience at all in my life. I didn't feel pain at all. But I woke up when entering the hospital and heard the voices of the nurses and doctors. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 2005/5/11 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Accident Direct head injury اصابة في فقرات العنق وتحرك فقرتين من الفقرات Other حادث سيارة How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal I felt a strange feeling indescribable, I thought of something which were very stupid I felt and doesn't deserve to think about life the assurance of my car, but I had a very comfortable feeling. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was totally unconscious. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain I felt I am in strange place. Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I was not seeing by my eyes but I could see it. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place لااستطيع وصفها فقدكنت الحق في جو جميل ورائع What emotions did you feel during the experience? Like a bird. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Remembered many past events Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Conservative/fundamentalist مسلم والحمد لله رب العالمين Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes My belief in God became deeper and clear. What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My belief in God became deeper and clear. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes My belief in God became deeper and deeper. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? No. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes The Islam described every details of those moments. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'as if I was flying on the air' and 'like a bird'; felt comfortable; no pain.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Reported being 'in strange place'; tunnel question answered 'Uncertain'.

environment.environment_other_detail: An 'unfamiliar, strange place' described as 'a beautiful and wonderful atmosphere'; did not feel heat though weather was very hot.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car accident with direct head/neck injury ('injury in cervical vertebrae and movement of two vertebrae').

person_demographics.occupation: Office worker (implied: 'out of my office after work').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard someone prompting Islamic words said before dying; regained awareness entering hospital and hearing nurses/doctors.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Comfortable feeling after impact; felt flying/out of body; perceived strange place/light; then woke upon entering hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported hearing someone on the road trying to get him to say the Islamic dying declaration: 'No Gods but one God, and Muhammad is a prophet of the God.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “After, I felt as if I was flying on the air.”; “Then I felt very happy moments I didn't experience at all in my life.”; “I was totally unconscious.”; “Experience was definitely real.”
